_comment: Single source of truth for latency budgets (TECH-SPEC.md sec 8.4). qa/latency.py and qa/live_ws_turn.py both load this file — never hardcode a copy elsewhere.

measured.providers: STT=faster-whisper tiny.en (local, tuned) / LLM=LiteLLM proxy gpt-oss-120b-groq / TTS=kokoro-local (in-process Kokoro-82M via mlx-audio), CHUNKED synthesis on (PET_TALK_TTS_CHUNKS=1, first chunk 4 words, later chunks 6)
measured.machine: M-series MacBook Pro, server under ~/miniconda3/envs/local-ml-py311. NOT A QUIET MACHINE: three other P0 lanes were building and testing on the same box throughout. Load average was 186 at the worst point and 16-20 during the runs recorded here, against a load of roughly 2 for the 2026-09-12b row. Every turn-level number below is therefore a CEILING, not this stack's capability, and the stt/stall regressions against 12b are machine load, not code — see the stage receipt in `notes`.
measured.method: Turn-level: live WS through the real FastAPI loop, `APP_PORT=8089 python3 qa/latency.py` x3 at N=5 turns, median of the three runs, real speech from qa/fixtures/weather_turn.wav (1.44s, 16kHz mono). Component-level: direct provider calls, N=9 for TTS and N=5 for STT, p50/p95. The TTS sentence is 13 words (the brief called it 12; it is 13 by plain split). `tts_ms` now measures the FIRST PLAYABLE AUDIO of a sentence — chunk 0 under chunked synthesis — because that is what a listener waits on; the whole-sentence figure is kept beside it.

stt_ms.note: 143.4 p50 on the quiet machine in the 12b row. Nothing in this lane touched STT.

measured.llm_first_content_ms: NOT MEASURED this pass — no component LLM run; unchanged from the 12b row (512.4 p50 / 805.4 p95)

tts_ms.result: PASS at p50; p95 clips the budget
tts_ms.what: time to the first playable audio chunk of a 13-word sentence, kokoro-local, N=9
tts_ms.note: Down from 236.6 p50 by chunked synthesis. The floor is ~110ms of fixed per-call overhead: a 3-word first chunk measured 136.7 p50 and a 2-word one 204.1, both WORSE, so 4 words is the setting. Gated real-engine test measured 174.4 p50 at N=5 on a busier moment.

tts_whole_sentence_ms.note: the same sentence with PET_TALK_TTS_CHUNKS=0. This is what every non-chunking tyre still pays.

stall_ms.note: Machine load, upstream of this lane. One turn's own stage receipt (server/turns.jsonl, t-latency-4): stt 700.3ms, stall 748.2ms — the stall lands 47.9ms after STT finishes, which is the warm cache hit working. On the 12b quiet machine the same path was 245.5ms.

first_audio_ms.what: first frame carrying playable audio, agent.chunk or agent.sentence, whichever lands first

turn_worst_ms.note: The cold-start breach is closed. `warm_stall_cache` pre-synthesizes the persona's stalls at startup (donna, 3 of 3, ~13s after boot, dominated by Kokoro's one-time model load), so the first turn of a fresh process no longer pays a full synth. PASS on all three runs, under load.

notes.live_ws_turn_gate: 3 single-shot runs: 387.8 PASS, 304.0 PASS, 703.7 FAIL against 400ms. Still N=1 and still flaky by design; the third run is the same machine load as stall_ms above.
notes.real_engine_e2e: PET_TALK_REAL_ENGINE=1 qa/test_real_engine_e2e.py 3/3 PASS. kokoro-local synthesised 278,444 bytes of valid RIFF; STT read it back; a live /ws turn drove Donna through the proxy to 210,044 bytes of playable audio.
notes.backward_compat: GET /audio/t-live-qa-1-s1 -> 200 audio/wav, 272,444 bytes on a chunked turn. The re-muxed whole-sentence WAV that audio_url serves is intact, so a client that ignores agent.chunk is unaffected.
notes.not_softened: No budget moved. tts_ms p95, stt_ms and stall_ms all still read FAIL against their written values.

history.providers: STT=faster-whisper tiny.en (local, tuned) / LLM=LiteLLM proxy gpt-oss-120b-groq / TTS=kokoro-local (in-process Kokoro-82M via mlx-audio)
history.method: Turn-level: live WS through the real FastAPI loop, `APP_PORT=8089 python3 qa/latency.py` x3 (N=5 turns each), median of the three runs, real speech from qa/fixtures/weather_turn.wav (1.44s, 16kHz mono). Component-level: direct provider calls (FasterWhisperSTT.transcribe / OpenAICompatibleLLM.stream / KokoroLocalTTS.synth), N=5, p50/p95. TTS sentence is 12 words; STT clip is the same fixture.

llm_first_content_ms.result: PASS at p50; p95 clips the budget — see docs/SPEC.md 9.1

turn_worst_ms.result: PASS warm / FAIL on the first turn of a fresh process

history.method: direct provider calls (GroqSTT.transcribe / OpenAICompatibleLLM.stream / KokoroSpacePilotTTS.synth), N=5, median of 5 (component-level only — see docs/SPEC.md 9.1 for why the live WS turn could not be measured this pass)
history._note: SUPERSEDED by the 2026-09-12b row. Kept as history: this is what the stack measured before the reasoning-token fix (llm), the in-process Kokoro tyre (tts), the tuned local Whisper (stt) and the real-audio fixture (which is why every turn-level metric here reads NOT MEASURED).
